verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships extensive, well-documented public REST APIs (issuing, transfers, batch transfers, FX, webhooks, banking-as-a-service, bills/expenses), plus SDKs, CLI, sandbox environment, scoped API keys, and OAuth-based partner connections, giving AI-native users comprehensive programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent third-party validation/hands-on testing beyond first-party docs.
